tagline: Finds and ranks the people who could actually sell your product for you

source.excerpt: Shared as a research pass over affiliate candidates, complete with contacts and draft outreach.

body:
## What it does

Works the recruiting end of an affiliate programme: it hunts by subject and by who is already promoting your rivals, rates what comes back, and narrows it to a shortlist worth your time. Each name arrives with a way to reach them and a first draft of the approach for you to edit. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @zilvestro shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
